body.statement: For every \(n_0,n_1\geq1\) and \(0<\beta<1\), \[\inf_{\mu_0,\mu_1\in\Delta_L}\Pr\{\mu_0\in C_0,\ \mu_1\in C_1\}\geq1-\beta.\] Moreover, \(\ell(S)\) equals the finite linear program minimizing \(\sum_{i-j\in S}\gamma_{ij}\) over nonnegative \(\gamma\) whose row marginal lies in \(C_1\) and column marginal lies in \(C_0\). Hence \[\inf_{\mu_0,\mu_1\in\Delta_L}\Pr\{h_{\mu}(S)\geq c\text{ for every }S\in\widehat{\mathcal H}\}\geq1-\beta,\] even when the reported subfamily is selected from \(\widehat{\mathcal H}\).
body.justification: A single simultaneous marginal event certifies all post-selected robust prediction sets without an additional multiplicity penalty.
body.gap: MalloyTripathyNowak2021 covers multinomial parameters and HuangFangHanleyRosenblum2019 treats a scalar ordinal bound; neither certifies a selected family of common-coupling effect sets.
body.consumer: Every reported set in a reanalysis of the Goldman trial receives an honest finite-sample certificate.
